TABLE Facility: One row per physical site (stadium, training facility, warehouse address) where a machine is or will be installed. Renamed from Location on 2026-08-23. Holds the address, the install-readiness site survey (lane, doors, power, internet, turf, ladder, cable protection) and the six site contacts. Links to Machines, Customer, Contact, Work Orders, Installs.
TABLE OOBF Checks: One row per out-of-box-failure checklist filed with a Work Order Summary (install / re-assembly visits). Each section is a multi-select of the specific failures seen. Created by the OOBF sub-form of the Work Order Summary Form.
TABLE Work Order Cost: One row per person per visit invoice, created by the Work Order Invoice Form (renamed from Work Order Invoicing on 2026-09-15). Hours and expenses come from the form; wage columns are written by the WO Invoice workflow from the person's Contact rates. Source of truth for technician invoices since 2026-09-10.
TABLE Work Order Summary: One row per person per visit (the report / story row): dates, scope done, photos, notes, machine-operable flag. Invoice money moved to Work Order Cost on 2026-09-10; the wage formulas here still compute for older rows.
NOTE Machines::LocationName: Field name kept from the Location era; target table is Facility.
NOTE Machines::dep-MachineNotes: dep- prefix = scheduled for removal; do not write to it.

NOTE Work Order Summary::WorkOrderSummar: Blank on rows created before 2026-08-26 and on hand-made rows.
NOTE Contracts::ContractPayments(USD): Renamed from ContractMonthlyPayments(USD); paired with ContractPaymentFrequency.
Contracts::ContractSubmissionRef: Fillout submission reference of the contract review
NOTE Contact::ContactSlackID: Used by Tech Briefs to invite/mention the person in WO channels. Blank = CC'd by email only.
